description: Plan-Do-See Diary (T06) — final database schema and date/aggregation rules. Source of truth is supabase/schema.sql; this file documents it for review.
timezone_rule: All calendar-date fields (period_start, period_end, due_date) represent an Asia/Seoul (KST, UTC+9) calendar day, stored as SQL `date` with no time component. All instant fields (started_at, ended_at, created_at, edited_at) are stored as `timestamptz` (UTC) and converted to KST only for display and for the 'is today past due' comparison.

plans.title: text
plans.priority: text, one of high | medium | low
plans.carried_over_note: text, nullable — improvement note copied in from a previous retrospective

plan_revisions.title: text
plan_revisions.rule: Before any update to a plan row, its current field values are copied into a new plan_revisions row first. The plans row itself is always the latest version; history is read from plan_revisions ordered by edited_at.

todos.title: text
todos.priority: text, one of high | medium | low
todos.deleted_at: timestamptz, nullable — soft delete so revision/record history stays intact

execution_records.actual_minutes: integer >= 0, derived from ended_at - started_at at creation time
execution_records.rule: Exactly one row is created per completion. The 'complete' action performs `UPDATE todos SET status='done' WHERE id=$1 AND status='active'` and only inserts an execution_records row when that update actually changed a row. A second, near-simultaneous click finds status already 'done', updates zero rows, and inserts nothing — this is what keeps double-clicking idempotent (T06-C21/C22/C27).

retrospectives.improvement_note: text — the one carry-over line chosen for this plan's retrospective
retrospectives.carried_over_to_plan_id: uuid, nullable, references plans.id — set once this note has been pulled into a new plan

aggregation_rules.plan_count: count of todos where plan_id = :plan and deleted_at is null
aggregation_rules.completed_count: count of the above where status = 'done'
aggregation_rules.delayed_count: count of the above where status = 'active' and due_date < today_in_kst() — completed todos are never counted as delayed, and a todo is counted at most once
aggregation_rules.blocked_count: count of the above where at least one linked execution_records row has a non-null, non-empty blocked_reason
aggregation_rules.estimated_minutes_total: sum(todos.estimated_minutes) over the same todo set; 0 if the set is empty
aggregation_rules.actual_minutes_total: sum(execution_records.actual_minutes) joined through todo_id over the same todo set; 0 if there are no records

public_access: No authentication exists in T06 by design — the results URL and all data are readable by anyone with the link, and RLS policies allow full anonymous read/write via the Supabase anon key. The service role key is never used from the client and never committed. Per-item locking is introduced in T07, not here.
